items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee (Rudy Van Gelder) is the recording engineer. The interviewer mentions that musicians from Benny Goodman's band visited him, but there is no evidence of a direct personal or professional relationship between Rudy Van Gelder and Benny Goodman himself, only that members of his band were

ctx.x: Was it just your friends or were there some others?

Well it was some friends, and some other musicians would use the theatre in Newark. These bands would appear and a couple of people—a trumpet player, who I know, worked in the band, in one of the bands. So they would come in and visit me and they’d have a band. All sorts of people would come visit me, everyone from Benny Goodman’s band to Jackie Cooper, the drummer. Maureen Sickler Oh so Jackie Cooper came to visit you?
